llm_judge_details.justification: The topology provides the standard 5G core VNFs and a URLLC slice, which matches the real‑time requirement, but it only models a single UE and gNB and lacks any edge or application components (e.g., dashboard, data aggregation) needed for 50 CNCs, 200 sensors, and 20 AGVs. Resource requests are very low (CPU in millicores, memory in Mi) and unlikely to support the implied device count or the 10 Gbps throughput SLA, indicating poor scaling. Slice type (SST 2) correctly aligns with the URLLC use case, and the SLA values (≤5 ms latency, high availability) are appropriate for the scenario.
